title: Use the title architect only when registered
what: Represent an individual as an architect only if the individual is a registered architect.

sources.title: Architects Act 2003 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An individual must not represent himself or herself to be an architect, and must not allow himself or herself to be represented to be an architect unless he or she is an architect

sources.title: Architects Act 2003 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 10, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: Board means the NSW Architects Registration Board constituted under this Act.
